body.zh: 足轻与武士建筑链、铁炮锻造建筑链、神社建筑链，以及 7 座尼朋专属地标（含海門「枪术道场／骑兵训练场」、御神木「晓行之里」、既知倶島「栖兽崖／海兽渊」等）。
body.en: Ashigaru and Samurai chains, matchlock forge chain, shrine chain, and 7 unique Nippon landmarks—including Kaimon's Yari Dojo / Cavalry Training Grounds, the Dawnbreakers' Haven at the Sacred Tree, and Kichikujima's Beast Cliffs / Abyss of Sea Beasts.

body.zh: 提督旗舰自带精简游牧建筑树（水师船舱、舰队火炮、船上马厩、新增禁卫专属的「亲卫营」，以及殷翎旗舰独有的海兽建筑链「万兽舱」）；同伴入队后其麾下兵种直接并入旗舰对应军营招募。
body.en: Each flagship carries a streamlined horde building tree—Naval Barracks, Naval Cannons, Shipboard Stables, the new Admiral's Guard chain for elite guards, and Yin Ling's exclusive Menagerie Hold chain for sea monsters—with companion units integrating directly into the corresponding flagship chains.
